authority: command/16.md for the comparison, user instruction of 2026-11-04 for this leg
scope: exactly one unperturbed R96 leg, strictly paired with the R96-M1 leg
purpose: measure the R96 numerical floor, which the registered short-wave discriminator records as unmeasured, and complete the A/B/C comparison at R96
forbidden: any change of the solver formulation

physics.canonical_mode: A28, Neumann m=2, one wavelength across the box

perturbation.note: no imposed perturbation; the leg measures what the discretization alone produces

physics.constitutive: unchanged from the frozen R48-M1 input; KrwMualemExponent = true

executable.provenance: the identical bundle that produced R24 and R48; no rebuild

numerics.cuts: the seven original conservative planes, byte-identical CutCoordinates

time_axis.pairing_rule: frame j of R96 pairs with frame j of R24/R48 (step 2j at dt/2 versus step j at dt)
time_axis.note: dt/2 is an exact binary halving, so the mathematical accepted times coincide identically; only the double accumulation differs. The 32-ULP same_time rule used inside one protocol is too tight across protocols and is replaced by the accumulation budget plus the exact frame-index identity.

deviation.reason: the per-step conservative diagnostics and sigma_top are written every accepted step irrespective of OutputInterval (main.cc: transport.write and writeSigmaTop precede the interval test), so interval 2 loses no diagnostic and no comparison time: the shared accepted times with R24/R48 are exactly the even steps
deviation.effect: 4801 frames instead of 9601; peak scratch 21.5 GiB instead of 43 GiB

execution.thread_backend: TBB, compiled into the frozen executable
execution.projection_source: the four-thread ten-step measurement, 0.842 s per step
execution.io_caveat: the sal legs wrote to a RAM-backed tmpfs; 4801 files on Lustre may be slower, so the projection is a floor, not a promise

host_and_threads_are_not_protocol_differ.rule: neither the host nor the thread count enters any protocol hash

acceptance: solver exit 0 with stop reason requested_horizon or a recorded solubility crossing
every accepted step uses the fixed dt; no Newton-driven reduction
accepted steps equal 9600 unless the solubility stop fired first
maximum regional salt residual <= 1e-14 m and water residual <= 1e-11 m (the WP7 thresholds)
independent VTU inventory, flux reintegration and budget identity reproduce the online budget
initial state matches the registered initial condition
no NaN or non-finite state anywhere in the diagnostics
frame count equals 4801 and every frame hash verifies at both ends
the paired time axis satisfies the registered accumulation budget at every shared frame
postprocessing: wp8_fields.py reduction, identical to the R24/R48 products
wp7_spatial.py metrics, identical to the R48 products
both run against hash-verified frames and audited

known_confounds.name: simultaneous timestep change
known_confounds.detail: R96 halves dx and dt together, so an R48-R96 difference cannot be attributed to horizontal resolution alone. The only existing bound is the WP6 R24 dt/2 pair to 2T: growth amplification -0.0999 percent, surface weighted sigma -0.1145 percent, vertical sigma profile relative L2 0.0389 percent, detection time +0.0972 percent. That bound does not extend to 3T-4T, to R96, or to the 1 mm transport difference, where the same study found a 68 percent mid-window change under dt halving.
known_confounds.consequence: growth and modal conclusions carry a ~0.1 percent temporal prior; transport conclusions carry none

known_confounds.name: domain width
known_confounds.detail: the box is one A28 wavelength wide with no-flow sides, so only Neumann modes m = 1,2,... exist and the LSA global critical mode nx=5 (wavelength 0.12 m) cannot appear at all
known_confounds.consequence: no statement about the unbounded-domain wavelength selection follows

known_confounds.name: vertical resolution
known_confounds.detail: nz=200 with Grading1=-0.98 is held fixed at every resolution and is not varied here
known_confounds.consequence: vertical truncation is common-mode and untested

known_confounds.name: executable provenance
known_confounds.detail: the strict one-cell background uses a different executable; only R24/R48/R96 share this one
known_confounds.consequence: background-referenced differences retain the cross-executable gap recorded in command/15

failure_policy: preserve the last accepted state, the solver log and all provenance
no automatic retry and no restart
